history.content: Can I afford a $400 trip to Austin next weekend?

Short answer: based on what you've logged, you're right at the line, so a $400 trip isn't clearly affordable from what I can see. Here's what I checked: your logged spending this week is $395 against a $400 budget (dining $275, Amazon $120). That leaves about $5 of headroom on the budget you've set. I have not actually checked your calendar yet, so I cannot say whether it is reachable. If the $400 budget is a weekly spending cap rather than your whole available cash, the trip may be fine, but I'd be guessing. If you want, tell me roughly what's in the account to spare and I'll give you a real yes/no. And if you do go, I can hunt down Austin flights and hotels for next weekend.
